blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Our teams are made of people. And people have good qualities. Today we learn five adjectives that describe great colleagues: kind, smart, helpful, friendly and reliable.

A kind colleague makes the day better. Smart people ask smart questions. Helpful colleagues save time. A friendly office is a happy office. And reliable teams deliver great work.

Today you will learn five important words. We go step by step. It is simple, and you can do it. Remember: English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts.

items.q: How many adjectives does the text teach today?
items.why: "Today we learn five adjectives."

items.q: According to the text, what do helpful colleagues do?
items.why: "Helpful colleagues save time."

items.q: What kind of office is a happy office?
items.why: "A friendly office is a happy office."

items.q: The text suggests that the author thinks learning these words is…
items.why: Inferência: "It is simple, and you can do it" e "English comes in CAN's" mostram um tom positivo e encorajador.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A kind colleague makes the day better
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "you can do it" — o autor discorda da ideia de que você não consegue aprender.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie descrevendo a equipe de RH. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I am Sophie, and I work in HR here at the company. Today I want to describe my team. They are great people, and I am happy to work with them every day.

First, there is Tom. Tom is very smart. He asks good questions, and he always finds a good answer. When a problem is difficult, I go to Tom. I like to work with him.

Then there is Ana. Ana is very helpful. When I have a lot of work, she helps me. She saves me a lot of time every week, and she never says no.

My manager is Lucas. Lucas is reliable. When he says yes, he does it. I can always count on him, and this is very good for the whole team.

And me? People say I am kind. I try to be nice to everyone. I think a kind office is a happy office, right?

Our team is friendly too. We say good morning, we help each other, and we work well together. I am really happy to be here. It is a great team, and I learn something new every day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "I am Sophie, and I work in HR."

items.q: Which word does Sophie use to describe Tom?
items.why: "Tom is very smart."

items.q: Why does Sophie like working with Ana?
options: Ana helps her and saves time
Ana is new on the team
items.why: "Ana is helpful… She saves me a lot of time."

items.q: Sophie says "I can always count on him" about Lucas. This suggests that Lucas…
items.why: Inferência: "reliable" + "count on him" mostram que Lucas cumpre o que diz.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about her team?
items.why: Inferência: "I am happy to be here. It is a great team!"

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Sophie is very kind. She helps new people every day." Kind means…
items.why: Kind = gentil, uma pessoa boa com os outros.

items.q: "Tom is smart. He always finds a good answer." Smart means…
items.why: Smart = inteligente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Ana is very ___. When I have a problem, she helps me."
items.why: Helpful = prestativo(a), quem ajuda.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The team is ___. We say good morning and we smile."
items.why: Friendly = amigável, uma equipe simpática.

items.q: "My manager is reliable. When he says yes, he does it." Reliable means…
items.why: Reliable = confiável, quem cumpre o que promete.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no trabalho em equipe. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Ana always helps out when we are busy." To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar os colegas.

items.q: "I can count on Lucas." To count on someone means to…
items.why: Count on = contar com alguém, confiar.

items.q: "Tom and I get along very well." To get along means to…
items.why: Get along = se dar bem com alguém.

items.q: "When I am away, Ana backs me up." To back someone up means to…
items.why: Back someone up = dar apoio, cobrir/apoiar o colega.

items.q: "Let's team up and finish the report together." To team up means to…
items.why: Team up = juntar-se para trabalhar em equipe.
